reuse.why: Builds on the shared recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate exactly as getUpcomingDates does; only the day parsing (`new Date(`${start}T12:00:00`)`) is hand-rolled instead of the months helpers.

duplication.why: The weekend move is delegated to the shared helper; the daily-skip rule (weekend occurrences of daily schedules dropped) is restated inline, as getNextDate also does, which is a small repeat.

placement.why: The handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and readable, with the date-moving rule kept in the shared function; the ±3-day window and the inline daily check are small implicit couplings to that rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared schedule helpers for rule building and weekend movement.

disguised_duplication.where: None beyond the one-line daily-weekend check.
